chunks: 4961 - And Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Isḥāq ibn Hilāl, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
That Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: 'Shall I not inform you of the gravest form of zina?'
They said, 'Yes.' He said: 'It is a woman who gives access to her husband's bed, then brings a child from other than him and imposes him upon her husband.'
So that is the one whom Allah will not speak to, nor look at on the Day of Judgment, nor purify her, and for her is a painful punishment.'

key_terms.أَكْبَرِ الزِّنَا: the gravest or greatest form of illicit sexual transgression
key_terms.بِوَلَدٍ: a child born as a result of the act
key_terms.فَتُلْزِمُهُ زَوْجَهَا: she attributes or ascribes the child to her husband
key_terms.فِرَاشَ زَوْجِهَا: her husband's marital bed, meaning the sanctity of the marriage bond
key_terms.وَلَا يُزَكِّيهَا: He will not purify or vindicate her

ai.seo_question: What does Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام describe as the gravest form of zina?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies a particularly grave form of zina as a woman's betrayal of the marital bed that results in attributing a child to a husband who is not the true father. The narration emphasizes the enormity of this act by linking it to severe disgrace and punishment in the Hereafter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4961 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Ishaq ibn Hilal, from Abu Abdillah (as), who said:
"Indeed, Commander of the Faithful (as) said: 'Shall I not inform you of the gravest form of adultery?'

They said: 'Yes.'
Imam (as) said: 'It is when a woman brings another man onto her husband's bed and bears a child from him, then attributes that child to her husband.
That woman is the one whom Allah (swt) will neither speak to nor look at on the Day of Judgment, nor will He (swt) purify her, and for her is a painful punishment.'"
